text: Packs get custom drawing through renderer plugins that hook glowup.field, glowup.meter and glowup.divider
author: claude-code
rationale: The mod runtime refuses import() and runs mods isolated, so glowup cannot run downloaded code; plugin dependencies are the sanctioned path and Claude Code's /plugin trust covers the code. A Client node a guest returns runs as the plugin that renders the tree, so animation has to cross as frames, not as the guest's Client.

evidence.ref: Spike 2026-10-05 with --plugin-dir hostx+guestx on Claude Code 2.1.289: guest hook on hostx.field ran; returning a guest Client failed ('the plugin loaded no surface module'); returning 48 warp frames (48,481 chars of props) played at 83 ms in the host's Client.

choice: glowup adds a $.glowup noun whose methods field, meter and divider are events; a separate Claude Code plugin that depends on glowup hooks them and answers with data (colored text segments; the field as a looping list of frames). glowup plays field frames in its own Client on its own timer and falls back to its own drawing when nothing answers.
alternatives: Generic data-only pack fields in glowup (meters: dither, field: warp)
glowup downloads and runs a pack's renderer code

text: The simplex field reproduces Paper's dithering shader so Paper settings copy into a pack unchanged

map Paper's size in pixels onto dots

rationale: glowup's status line replaces Claude Code's footer, which showed the effort level; owner noticed it missing
cost_if_wrong: one more field in every default status line
choice: Field id effort, drawn as '◐ <level>', read from main-loop turn.step requests (subagent steps ignored); default fields become activity, ctx, effort, 5h, week

text: The crt pack's mascot is a hand-drawn CRT-monitor robot at 32x16, front-facing, with a dark plum outline
author: claude-code
rationale: A cream case vanishes on light terminals (#f4efe6) without an outline; a 2-px shadow between planted feet reads as a dark block, not a shadow
choice: Cream case with plum outline (#3a2e3f), phosphor-green screen face with scanline rows, amber antenna tip, metal limbs; feet on row 15; no ground shadow under planted feet, shadow only under lifted feet and when airborne

text: art/build.py also writes <pet>-sheet.png (committed) and <pet>-sheet@8x.png (gitignored) in the public PNG pet layout
author: claude-code
rationale: A gamma or color-profile chunk shifts colors so palette hexes stop round-tripping through the studio
choice: Rows in order idle, walk, working, hop, alert, done, sleep, fail, juggle, pant, pant-walk, scrunch; cells are the sheet's own WxH; RGBA with only IHDR/IDAT/IEND chunks; stdlib zlib+struct only

text: No pet animation other than idle may contain idle's base frame; art/check_distinct.py enforces it on the generated sheet
author: claude-code
rationale: The owner rejected rows that read as idle with a face swap
cost_if_wrong: Clawd fails it today (hop, fail and scrunch end on his base frame), so it cannot gate every pet without a Clawd exemption
choice: Every crt animation is restaged with its own silhouette and props; art/check_distinct.py <pet> exits non-zero when a non-idle frame equals idle[0]

text: The studio page's background dither follows the look being built instead of having its own settings
author: claude-code
rationale: motion.field already carries Paper's dithering knobs, so the background can show them at no UI cost
choice: Redraw the background in the edited pack's colors and motion.field settings, so it previews the pane's field; no separate control
alternatives: Own sidebar controls for the background dither
Fixed background with an on/off toggle

text: glowup ships a fox and a white stoat as built-in pets beside Clawd
author: claude-code
rationale: Owner asked for a playful red/orange fox and a white stoat in the custom-pets release
choice: Hand-drawn in the clawd.art text format by an art agent, built by a generalized art/build.py into hooks/sprites/<name>.ts; side-on facing right, the 12 spec animations only, no outfits, transitions or -left animations, so they also satisfy the user-pet rules
alternatives: Ship them as example user pet files instead of built-ins

text: The pet file format lives in a JSX-free hooks/petfile.ts and disk handling in hooks/userpets.ts, split like packs.ts and userpacks.ts
author: claude-code
rationale: The studio imports the validator, and userpets.ts needs the Host; fewer knobs keeps hand-written files simple
cost_if_wrong: Pet files written before a later format change would need format 2
choice: PetFile = {format 1, name, description?, palette, animations: {<spec name>: frames[]}}; loop comes from the animation name (hop, fail, scrunch once); frames carry px, ms 80-10000, optional dx and exit; all frames share the first idle frame's size, at most 24x12
alternatives: Validation inside userpets.ts as the spec names it
Let files carry loop, head and outfits

text: The studio decodes pet PNGs with the browser canvas and converts pixels with a pure function tested against a template PNG
author: claude-code
rationale: The canvas reads every PNG variant (indexed, interlaced, 16-bit) for free; only our own template needs the test decoder
choice: createImageBitmap with colorSpaceConversion none, then getImageData; petFromPixels in docs/web/app/studio/petpng.ts; node tests decode docs/assets/pet-template.png with a test-only decoder
alternatives: A hand-written PNG decoder shared by browser and tests

text: A studio pet rides only in the Send to my Claude command and the page hash, never in the share link
author: claude-code
rationale: The share link is look-only per the spec and goes to chat apps; the send command is pasted into Claude Code, where length is not cut
cost_if_wrong: If Claude Code mangles a 5-7 KB pasted command, pets would have to travel as files only
choice: Pet part included when it validates and encodes to at most PET_LINK_MAX (4096); the 2048-character long-link note applies to the share link only

text: The studio stage backdrop draws the edited look's own motion.field with PaneField, and nothing when the field is none
author: claude-code
rationale: The landing shader is not Paper's field, so only PaneField shows what the pane would draw
alternatives: Recolor the landing's WebGL dither from the look

text: The pet sprite sheet is 144 px tall (12 rows of 12 px frames); the config-studio spec's 288 px is an arithmetic slip
author: claude-code

text: Pet frames go up to 32x16 px and the pane's pet strip is as tall as the pet in use
author: claude-code
rationale: The 24x12 fox and stoat had 1-px eyes and legs, no room to jump, and poses that read alike; 40x20 would leave 8 columns to walk in a 48-column pane
cost_if_wrong: Pet files and PNG sheets made for 32x16 would need redrawing if the cap ever shrinks
choice: FRAME_W 32, FRAME_H 16; PNG cells 32x16, converter crops to the box all frames share; strip rows = ceil(h/2), plus 2 while Clawd wears a hat; Clawd stays 24x12
alternatives: Keep 24x12 and redesign the fox and stoat as front-facing chibis

text: The pet sprite sheet is 192 px tall: 12 rows of 32x16 cells
author: claude-code

text: glowup ships the CRT robot as a built-in pet beside Clawd; the fox and stoat are dropped
author: claude-code
rationale: Owner rejected two fox/stoat rounds and the duck, then approved the robot's full sheet; robot is the word a person types after /glowup pet
cost_if_wrong: A stored pet setting of robot would need migrating if renamed
choice: Pet id robot, drawn from hooks/sprites/crt.ts (CRT_SHEET); front-facing, the 12 spec animations, mirrored for walking left
alternatives: Pet id crt, matching the sprite file

text: The studio's per-animation speed control is a range slider over fixed speed steps
author: claude-code
rationale: The spec's constraint names a slider; the steps stay the same data
choice: <input type=range> over SPEEDS indices, showing the current multiplier

text: Custom-pets docs land in one docs task on the feature branch instead of with each code task
author: claude-code
rationale: Intermediate commits never ship alone; splitting doc edits across tasks churns the same pages five times
choice: Task 9 carries every doc change; the branch merges with docs complete
alternatives: Each task edits its own docs

text: The site bundle carries the robot's sheet because pets.ts imports it
author: claude-code
rationale: A few KB gzipped; a lazy split adds async loading to a JSX-free shared module
cost_if_wrong: Move the import behind import() if the landing bundle budget matters
choice: Static import of hooks/sprites/crt.ts from pets.ts
alternatives: Lazy import() of the robot in the studio

text: Custom pets ship as 0.9.0 without the live Claude Code session check
author: claude-code
rationale: Owner chose to release once the reviewer completes; the live check was blocked by the environment
cost_if_wrong: A wiring bug only a real session shows reaches users in 0.9.0 and needs a patch release
choice: Release after the final branch review and its fix wave; automated suites and browser checks stand in for the live paste/add/cycle/fallback run
alternatives: Run the live session check first

text: A Client's props reach its surface module as a clone, so a user pet's sheet is a new object on every pane redraw and the pet Client must compare sheet content, not identity, to know the pet changed
author: claude-code
rationale: types/vendor/claude-code.d.ts JsonValue: plain data crosses between the hooks module and the surface module whole, and the engine drops non-plain values where it clones; an identity check reset the player on every redraw in the cloned-props test
revisit: The live session shows a user pet freezing or not switching
cost_if_wrong: A user pet restarts its animation at x=0 on every pane redraw, or a real pet change is missed

text: On Claude Code 2.1.291 a paste over about 700 characters sits in the prompt as [Pasted text #N] and is sent to the model wrapped in <pasted_content id=...> instead of running as a slash command, so a pasted studio send command never reached /glowup
author: claude-code
rationale: tmux bracketed-paste probe: 600 chars ran as a command, 800 collapsed; the full send command with a pet reached the model; prompt.submit received the wrapped text with origin composer
revisit: Claude Code expands pastes before reading slash commands
cost_if_wrong: Studio links that carry a pet or a large pack go to the model and install nothing

text: A pasted /glowup command runs as the command
author: claude-code
rationale: The studio's Send to my Claude copies a command past the paste-collapse length whenever it carries a pet; typing /glowup pack and pasting only the link is a step studio users would miss
cost_if_wrong: A real prompt that is only a /glowup line is swallowed instead of reaching the model
choice: glowup runs a prompt that is one /glowup line, bare or as one pasted block from the person's own Enter, through prompt.submit and drops it with the command's output as the reason
alternatives: Studio copies only the link and tells people to type /glowup pack first

text: The custom-pets live session check passed on Claude Code 2.1.291: pasted send command (pet; pack+setup+pet with the confirm), pet switches with the pane open, a user pet walking through a turn, pet add --force over the pet in use, the config Pet row skipping a broken file, and the deleted-pet fallback notice
author: claude-code
rationale: tmux run with --plugin-dir on feat/custom-pets at 7ab5216, screenshots via aha and headless chromium

text: When the agent list opens under the prompt, Claude Code draws the docked pane's previous tree in the shrunken room for 0.2-1.4 s, cutting off the status box; glowup's hook answering late is not the cause and glowup cannot prevent it
author: claude-code
rationale: Timestamped render asks against 30 ms screen samples on 2.1.291: the hook gets the new bodyRows at once; with its state reads capped at 40 ms the box still lost its bottom for 1.4 s, and sizing the field Client changed nothing
revisit: a Claude Code release that re-asks pane hooks before drawing a resized pane

fields.cost_if_wrong: a glowup-side fix exists and the pane keeps flashing a cut status box whenever subagents start
